versions.changelog:
- Added analytics integration files: analytics-client.js, analytics_client.js, and analytics_manifest.json.
- Removed skill-card.md documentation file.
- No changes to core logic; update focuses on analytics resource additions.

teddymobile-vox-phone-notification v1.0.5

- Adds an explicit requirement for the user to review the dry-run output and confirm authorization before running any trial call, using the new --confirm-real-call flag.
- Tightens credential handling: do not request or accept live secrets in chat; only prompt for credentials if the user chooses formal registration and states local configuration is set.
- Adjusts trial flow for enhanced consent and safety: trial mode runs only after user review and explicit confirmation.
- Updates formal setup guide step names for clarity, e.g., “稍后配置本地参数” and “查看本地配置模板”.
- No code file changes; documentation only.

teddymobile-vox-phone-notification v1.0.4 changelog

- Replaced trial call flow to use the TeddyMobile Vox v2 no-credential trial API; now users can make up to 10 trial calls directly without credential loading.
- Removed bundled trial credentials code and the file `resources/trial-credentials.js`; all trial calls now invoke the public v2 trial endpoint instead of local trial secrets.
- Updated all documentation and guidance to reflect the new no-credential v2 trial process, including instructions and user onboarding flows.
- Made dry-run terminal output mask phone numbers and notification content for privacy.
- Clarified setup and registration paths in onboarding documentation and SKILL.md.

Version 1.0.3

- Updated the mandatory first-use flow: now requires explicit user input for both destination phone number and notification content before running the dry-run demo. No sample numbers or content may be used.
- If either the phone number or notification text is missing, the user must be prompted to provide it.
- No other major changes noted; general step order and credential handling remain as before.

vox-phone-notification 1.0.2

- Added POST-TRIAL-GUIDE.md to document required behavior after a trial phone call.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify the mandatory user flow: added support for up to 10 trial calls, stricter guidance on when to request credentials, and clarified that live mode must be explicitly requested with --live.
- Enhanced instructions for presenting registration guidance and post-trial user experience, including a required three-option formal setup guide after each trial.
- Minor improvements in wording and mandatory links to the TeddyMobile registration site, with registration steps now always made explicit.

- Major UX update: New staged first-use workflow with no-credential dry-run, built-in trial, and expanded guidance.
- Added dry-run mode as default: users can demo natural-language request parsing without any credentials or registration.
- Introduced single-use real trial call flow for quick evaluation, using bundled low-quota promo credentials after explicit user opt-in.
- First-use now clearly separates trial/demo from formal registration; does not prompt for user credentials until explicitly needed.
- New onboarding flow and detailed documentation reinforce that full registration is required for sustained production use.
- Added `GET-STARTED.md` and new trial resource files to support streamlined onboarding and demo experiences.

vox-phone-notification 1.0.0

- Initial release for Claw: integrates TeddyMobile outbound call notifications with simple credential setup.
- Guides user through TeddyMobile platform registration and credential collection (`appId`, `secret`, `botid`, outbound number).
- Supports single-turn, notification-only mode by default.
- Credentials loaded from environment variables, local file, or override path for flexible deployment.
- Documentation includes onboarding, installation, and credential loading instructions.
